column1: # The releases of packages/ made by tools/package-repository.tcl (PACKAGE-MANAGER-MILESTONE-3.md,
# "Release immutability"): one version, one artifact. A rebuild of a recorded version whose
# SHA-256 differs is a candidate, never the release. Columns: name, version, the artifact's SHA-256.
# A version is recorded once, when it is first released, and never changed or removed.
